required_fields.colmap_model: Path or package-relative reference to the COLMAP model used by the evaluator.
required_fields.gaussian_frame: Coordinate frame of the Gaussian geometry or rendered depth.
required_fields.survey_crs: Survey horizontal CRS, e.g. CGCS2000 / 3-degree Gauss-Kruger CM 108E, EPSG:4545.
required_fields.height_datum: Vertical datum, e.g. 1985 National Height Datum for normal height.
required_fields.camera_model: COLMAP camera model and parameter convention.
required_fields.pixel_coordinate_convention: Pixel coordinate convention, e.g. zero-indexed pixel centers.
required_fields.depth_semantics: Formal evaluator accepts camera_z, ray_distance, inverse_camera_z, or inverse_ray_distance. The current Graphdeco-derived alpha_weighted_unnormalized_inverse_camera_z artifact must be rejected for formal depth-only evaluation unless normalized/exported differently.
required_fields.depth_units: Depth unit after scale/offset conversion, normally meters in the camera/model frame.

optional_fields.wgs84_companion_fields: WGS84 latitude/longitude/ellipsoid-height fields if included for provenance.
optional_fields.depth_scale: Scale applied to stored depth values.
optional_fields.depth_offset: Offset applied after scaling stored depth values.
optional_fields.alpha_map_available: Whether a per-pixel alpha/accumulation map is available.
optional_fields.depth_second_moment_available: Whether a depth second-moment or variance map is available.
optional_fields.renderer_repository: Repository path or anonymized package reference used to produce depth maps.
optional_fields.renderer_commit: Exact renderer/source commit used for depth export.
optional_fields.renderer_source_trace: Source files and hashes that define payload["depth"].
optional_fields.mapping_csv: Image-name to depth-path mapping with width and height for each depth map.
optional_fields.method_output_contract: Reference to the method output contract file.
